 HARD WORK, GOALS AND ASSISTS 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article His goal tally could grow as the team creates more chances and poses a greater threat in the opposition half (three goals so far across Serie A and the Europa League), but Gonçalo Ramos is already playing a crucial role in Rúben Amorim 's tactical system at AC Milan . The statistics highlight a highly mobile center-forward who frequently drops into midfield. In Serie A, the Portuguese striker leads all forwards in interceptions and ball recoveries, while ranking second among forwards in receptions, touches and duels contested and won. He also ranks third in completed passes and leads all forwards in touches in both the middle third and his own half. His physical presence and competitive intensity also place him among the leading forwards for fouls committed and drawn.
 Ramos' hard work deserves to be rewarded more often in front of goal. AC Milan aims to provide him with greater support in and around the box, creating more chances and supplying him more frequently through the middle to help him manage his energy more effectively. The Portuguese striker has already made his mark with goals and assists. He scored his first goal against Venezia (August 28th, 2026) and his second against Atalanta (October 18th, 2026), one of them from the penalty spot. He also provided two assists in the wins over Lecce (September 20th, 2026) and Genoa (November 8th, 2026). Against Lecce, he was also involved in the build-up to Diego Moreira's third goal. In the Europa League, he scored his only European goal after coming off the bench in the 4-0 away win over Red Bull Salzburg (October 15th, 2026) .
